text: みち　いっぽん　ちがう　だけで　とれる　ポケモンも　ちがうぜ！

structure.jp: みち　いっぽん　ちがう　だけで
structure.en: just by being one road over

structure.jp: とれる　ポケモンも
structure.en: the Pokémon you can catch too

patterns.name: 〜だけで
patterns.explanation: だけで means 'just from that alone', showing how little it takes. みち いっぽん ちがう だけで = 'just by being one road apart'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: The える ending turns 'catch' into 'can catch'. とれる = 'can catch'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. とれる ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you can catch'.
